bagPolicy.summary: All guests and bags are screened before entry. Review the current official allowed/prohibited-items list before packing, because festival security may refuse or dispose of noncompliant items.
bagPolicy.note: The 2026 FAQ and first-timer guide are the source of truth for event entry rules.

parking.note: Riot Fest strongly recommends CTA, bicycle, taxi, or rideshare instead of neighborhood parking. The main entrance is at W. Ogden Ave. and S. Sacramento Dr.; complimentary ADA parking is along S. Sacramento Dr. across from that entrance and requires a valid placard or plate.
lots: ADA parking along S. Sacramento Dr.

rideshare.note: Riot Fest recommends cab or rideshare service to Douglass Park. Use the main entrance area at W. Ogden Ave. and S. Sacramento Dr. and follow event-day traffic controls in the app.

concessions.note: Food, beverage, and retail vendors operate throughout the festival; free water refill stations are provided. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ areas include dedicated food and bar options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The grounds include accessible routes linking parking, entrances, stages, viewing areas, vendors, and activity areas. Free first-come ADA parking is across from the main entrance on S. Sacramento Dr.; a verified placard or license plate is required.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: GA tickets permit one entry per day and do not include same-day re-entry. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ wristbands permit re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: GA tickets are electronic and can be scanned at the gate. VIP, Deluxe, and Deluxe+ wristbands may be shipped or held for will call according to the order confirmation; the main box office is near S. Sacramento Blvd. and W. Ogden Ave.

gates.title: Entrance & Gates
gates.body: The 2026 main entrance and box office are near S. Sacramento Blvd. and W. Ogden Ave. Main gates are scheduled to open at 11:00 a.m. each festival day, subject to change.
